name: Qu Yuan
contribution: A Chinese poet and political figure of the State of Chu during the Warring States period.
legacy: He is considered to have initiated the so-called sao style of verse, which is named after his work Li Sao, in which he abandoned the classic four-character verses used in poems of Shi Jing and adopted verses with varying lengths.

checks.lead: Qu Yuan (c. 340 BC – 278 BC) was a Chinese poet and political figure of the State of Chu during the Warring States period.
